name: infinite-scroll
description: Loads the next page when the end of a list scrolls into view

meta.name: InfiniteScroll
meta.description: Loads the next page when the end of a list scrolls into view

props.name: onLoadMore
props.description: Called when the sentinel comes into view, or the button is activated; the spinner shows until it settles

props.name: disabled
props.description: When true, stops observing and renders nothing — there are no more pages.

props.name: rootMargin
props.description: How far ahead of the end to start loading, as an IntersectionObserver root margin.

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides for the component’s user-visible strings (i18n).

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS class names merged onto the root element.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Place it as the last child of the scrolling region, after the list.

examples.title: Stopping at the last page
examples.description: Renders nothing and stops observing once there is nothing left to load.

examples.title: Loading earlier
examples.description: Starts the next page well before the user reaches the end.

whenToUse: A long, page-fetched feed or list where the user should keep reading without a page break
Search or media results that stream in as the user scrolls
Mobile screens where numbered pagination would be awkward to hit
whenNotToUse: Content the user needs to navigate back into by position — use Pagination so URLs stay addressable
Lists with a footer below them, which infinite loading makes unreachable
A fixed, fully-loaded dataset — render it, or virtualize it, instead of faking pages

antiPatterns.bad: Leaving `disabled` false after the last page
antiPatterns.why: A sentinel that stays in view keeps re-firing `onLoadMore` against an exhausted source

antiPatterns.bad: Rendering it outside the element that scrolls
antiPatterns.good: Place it as the last child of the scrolling region
antiPatterns.why: The observer watches the sentinel against the nearest scroll root; outside it, intersection never changes

related.name: Pagination
related.reason: Addressable, position-stable paging when back-navigation matters

related.name: PullToRefresh
related.reason: Refreshes the head of the same list the InfiniteScroll extends

related.name: Spinner
related.reason: Shows the Spinner while the load promise settles

intent.a11yRationale: The trigger is a real button, not a bare sentinel, so the next page is reachable by keyboard and by screen reader rather than only by scrolling — the standing accessibility complaint against scroll-only infinite lists. The IntersectionObserver activates the same code path the button does, so pointer and assistive-technology users converge on identical behaviour. While a page is in flight the button is replaced by a role="status" region carrying the loading string from the i18n catalog, which announces politely. Re-entry is guarded on a loading flag, so a sentinel still in view after a short page cannot loop. Because the component requires client JavaScript, server-render the first page as real content rather than relying on it.

flexibility.note: How far ahead of the end loading starts (default 200px)
May return a promise; the spinner persists until it settles
Always renders an activatable button — there is no sentinel-only mode
